clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Windtotem the Elder receives travelers on a bluff above Ratchet. She welcomes those who honor the wisdom of ages past and offers an ancestral blessing and guidance to other elders across Kalimdor.

On a grassy hill just northwest of Ratchet’s flight master, Windtotem the Elder watches over the goblin docks and open sea. Iron, gunpowder, and coin pass through the harbor below, while quiet Barrens winds and a shaft of celestial light reach the elder.

During the Lunar Festival, Windtotem the Elder guides wandering mortals, as do the other ancestral spirits. Those who seek her receive her blessing and a token of her favor, along with whispers pointing to nearby elders across the continent, including Elder Runetotem and Elder Bloodhoof.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
